title: So's Conjecture for Integral Circulant Graphs of Order p^aq
summary: So conjectured that, for a fixed positive integer n, the ordinary adjacency spectrum of an integral circulant graph of order n determines its divisor set. We prove this for graphs of order p to the power a times q, where p and q are primes with p less than q and a is at least one. To handle coincident eigenvalues arising from distinct greatest-common-divisor classes, we use a spectral counting measure.
